mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlements (work_case_id, amount, status) VALUES (#{workCaseId}, #{amount}, 'WAITING')
mapper.sql: id AS settlementId, work_case_id AS workCaseId, amount AS amount, status AS status, approved_by_user_id AS approvedByUserId, due_at AS dueAt, processing_at AS processingAt, completed_at AS completedAt, failure_code AS failureCode, retry_count AS retryCount, last_failure_at AS lastFailureAt, next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM settlements WHERE work_case_id = #{workCaseId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM disputes WHERE work_case_id = #{workCaseId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW') FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE settlements SET status = 'ON_HOLD', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
UPDATE settlements SET status = 'SCHEDULED', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'ON_HOLD'
UPDATE settlements SET status = 'SCHEDULED', due_at = #{dueAt}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE work_case_id = #{workCaseId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND due_at IS NULL

UPDATE settlements SET status = 'PROCESSING', approved_by_user_id = #{approvedByUserId}, processing_at = NOW(6), failure_code = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND processing_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL

UPDATE settlements SET status = 'PROCESSING', approved_by_user_id = NULL, processing_at = NOW(6), failure_code = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND due_at <= #{eligibilityTime} AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{eligibilityTime}) AND processing_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL

UPDATE settlements SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND approved_by_user_id <=> #{approvedByUserId} AND processing_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS settlementId, s.work_case_id AS workCaseId FROM settlements s WHERE s.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND s.due_at <= #{eligibilityTime} AND (s.next_retry_at IS NULL OR s.next_retry_at <= #{eligibilityTime}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM disputes d WHERE d.work_case_id = s.work_case_id AND d.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW') ) ORDER BY s.due_at ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT retry_count FROM settlements WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND processing_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE settlements SET failure_code = #{failureCode}, last_failure_at = NOW(6), next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND processing_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL AND retry_count <= 3

UPDATE settlements SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, last_failure_at = NOW(6), next_retry_at = NULL, retry_count = LEAST(retry_count + 1, 5), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND processing_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL

UPDATE settlements SET status = 'PROCESSING', approved_by_user_id = #{approvedByUserId}, processing_at = NOW(6), failure_code = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND due_at IS NULL AND processing_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL

UPDATE settlements SET status = 'REFUNDED', completed_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND approved_by_user_id = #{approvedByUserId} AND due_at IS NULL AND processing_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
